notes.subject: iñakãrakũva Amalek-pe
notes.rationale: שרשם בעמלק: 'root of them against Amalek' (KJV) vs 'root in Amalek' (JPS, mixing with Amalekites) vs 'their root sprouted in Amalek territory'.

notes.subject: taijohára
notes.rationale: מחקקים: 'lawgivers' (from חקק engrave statutes) vs 'governors' (KJV/ASV) vs 'scribes'.

notes.subject: taʼýra taijohára mbaʼéva
notes.rationale: שבט ספר: 'staff of the scribe' vs 'marshal's staff' (JPS/ASV) vs 'pen of the writer' (KJV) — the same two words read three ways.

notes.subject: מחקקים / ספר
notes.rationale: both tokens pivot on engraving/marking — statutes, scribes, staffs all from one image-field, partially preserved in 'taijohára' twice.

translation: Efraim-gui osẽ umi iñakãrakũva Amalek-pe; nde rire, Binjamin, nde retãnguéra apytépe; Makir-gui onoʼã umi taijohára, ha Sebulon-gui umi oityva ⟨taʼýra⟩ taijohára mbaʼéva.
